document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The men force Norman and Sylvia, in turn, to kneel between 
two small trees, and affix one wrist per tree. Then they dance 
in grotesque glee. The light at the focus of their ritual shifts 
between  colors. The  movements  continue  until  you  notice  a 
dwarf who holds a crescent blade on a handle. When the dance 
ends and the participants begin to leap and shriek, the blade 
wielder approaches Norman.

You shriek as the blade is swung and Norman’s head is struck 
off. Sylvia turns white and faints. Her head is severed while she 
is still unconscious.

Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 263; if the result is odd, go 
to 265.
